name: Diplomatic Relations
source:
You're the Princess of Dealtry, sent to marry the Khan of Bayan and secure an alliance between your countries. But your bride-to-be is proving elusive, and there's more than one distraction to be found in your new home.

[From [url=https://farryn.itch.io/diplomatic-relations]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是迪尔特里公国的公主，被派去嫁给巴彦汗，以确保两国结盟。然而，你的未婚妻行踪难觅，而新家中还有不止一个诱惑等待着你。

[来源：[url=https://farryn.itch.io/diplomatic-relations]Itch.io[/url]]
